hint.en: PELS runs the device in the cheapest hours before the ready-by time, within the hard cap and, unless you allow more, the daily budget, until it has taken this much energy, counted from its power readings. For on/off devices with no temperature or battery reading, like a water heater on a relay; the device needs a live power reading. A water heater that switches itself off once hot stops taking energy, so the task can end short of its target. The task auto-disables once the deadline passes; run this card from a recurring Flow (for example every evening at 22:00) to set it up for the next night.
